reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text squarely supports it: clause 2.1 states 'No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies' and that declining to place a further Order Form is 'not a breach or shortfall', which meets the preferred position (fees for ordered services only).

Corroborating clauses are correctly read: 7.1 bars any unidentified minimum-use charge and 12.3 confirms no minimum-volume or exclusivity commitment, so no take-or-pay or volume floor exists anywhere in the cited material.
No redline and no comment were produced, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals and no deterministic checks failed.
The 'shortfall' references in the audit provisions are appropriately characterised as an underpayment true-up rather than a take-or-pay penalty, consistent with the rule's preference for true-ups.
The late-payment liquidated damages point is expressly flagged as awareness-only and deferred to the payment-terms rule, correctly avoiding double-flagging under this rule.
